title: 魔腾 · 星星风铃
description: 柔软影子般的魔腾飘在月牙垫上，安静看着小星星风铃。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Nocturne retains a floating dark shadow body, pointed hornlike head, glowing blue-violet eyes, and two recognizable curved blade-shaped forearms. Simplify the silhouette into a friendly rounded dream creature, with smooth crayon edges and no exposed sharp details or frightening face.
art_direction.scene: He floats just above a crescent-shaped cushion, watching three paper stars sway from a little mobile. Both curved forearms rest low and outward, safely away from the stars, and the misty lower body forms one clear soft swirl. Keep the composition spacious and peaceful, with visible wax-crayon strokes, warm paper margins, and every important prop clearly separated.
art_direction.palette: midnight blue, lilac, pale yellow, dusty teal, cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
